title: Reader Chapter 32
hook: A reader-facing chapter under phase-1 review.

examples.title: Ulric lines up the agenda
examples.scenario: Ulric squares a marked-up agenda at Tuesday 8:57 a.m. in Conference Room C at Pelham Transit, operations analyst, with a water glass sweating onto the table. The director cut off his safety report last week. Ulric has a speech about how nobody listens to data. His own notes show a cleaner truth: I felt dismissed when the signal failure was moved to new business. Ulric he must decide whether to accuse the room or speak from his own view.
examples.whyItMatters: It shows the skill in context.

examples.title: Hester opens the notebook beside two coffees
examples.scenario: Hester touches two untouched coffees at Monday 7:03 a.m. in a corner table at Rowan's Cafe, school counselor, with a notebook with five bullet points. Her colleague is late again to crisis coverage. Hester has prepared the layers, a neutral start, and one request. When he walks in smiling, the old angry speech rushes back. Hester she must decide whether to follow the sequence or chase the heat.
examples.whyItMatters: It shows the skill in context.
